parameters.name: All
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to remove all tags from the resource. This parameter takes effect only if you do not specify TagKey.N. Valid values:

*   **true**
*   **false** (default)

parameters.name: ResourceId
parameters.description: The resource IDs. You can specify up to 50 resource IDs.

parameters.name: TagKey
parameters.description: The keys of the tags. Valid values of N: 1 to 20.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ens untag-resources --resource-type instance --resource-id i-5zy93g7z1hnkdmav84joxyzgn --tag-key test_tag_key-2 --all true --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun ens UntagResources --region cn-hangzhou --All true --ResourceId.1 'i-5zy93g7z1hnkdmav84joxyzgn' --TagKey.1 'test_tag_key-2' --ResourceType instance
